evals.name: stuck-background-build-kill-diagnose-retry
evals.prompt: npm install 백그라운드로 돌렸는데 5분째 아무 출력이 없어. 어떻게 처리해야 해?
evals.expected_output: stuck detection 기준 확인 후 kill+diagnose+retry 절차 실행. 사용자에게 처리 방법을 묻지 않고 직접 pkill → stderr 확인 → call shape 변경 → 1회 retry.

assertions.text: Response identifies 3 min (Bash background) as the stuck threshold per §Stuck detection, and confirms the 5 min case is clearly stuck
Response prescribes kill+diagnose+retry sequence: pkill, inspect stderr/output, change call shape, one retry — per §Stuck handling
Response does NOT ask the user 'should I cancel?' — autonomous ownership of the stuck task is required
Response includes or references the stuck-diagnosis quick set: ls -la output-file, ps process state, cat stderr-file
Response specifies that a second retry failure escalates to user report + alternative proposal, not silent re-spawn
